lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Compliance memo CM-2004-011 - hazardous areas, solvent handling
Hazardous area classification of the solvent room and the dispersing hall completed:
zone 1 at open vessels and drum transfer points, zone 2 elsewhere.
Equipotential bonding is required for all conductive containers during the transfer of
SOP-07 bonding step confirmed as a legal requirement.
